name: momentum-companion-shell
description: Lumina, an AI companion for Momentum life insurance policies: host portal, embedded companion, and a backend doing role-aware servicing and grounded policy answers over the Myriad guide.

scripts.quickstart: npm run setup && (docker compose up -d db || echo "No Docker: skipping the database. The hello-world flow runs without it.") && npm run install:all && npm run dev
scripts.install:all: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix host install && npm --prefix companion install && npm --prefix companion-backend install
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d db
scripts.db:corpus: gunzip -c db/rag-corpus.sql.gz | docker exec -i companion-db psql -U companion -d companion
